info.title: Default Bedrock Runtime Inference Target Schema
info.description: Default OpenAPI schema for Amazon Bedrock Runtime inference targets. Strict superset of the Bedrock Mantle schema: bedrock-runtime exposes the same OpenAI-compatible APIs (/v1/chat/completions, /v1/responses, /v1/messages) plus the native InvokeModel APIs (/model/{model}/invoke and /model/{model}/invoke-with-response-stream) whose request body is a union of all Bedrock model-family shapes. All objects allow additional properties for forward compatibility.

post.description: Creates a model response for the given chat conversation using Amazon Bedrock models. Compatible with the OpenAI Chat Completions API format. Supports streaming via server-sent events when stream is set to true. Supports Amazon Bedrock Guardrails via extra headers.

schema.description: SSE stream of ChatCompletionChunk objects when stream is true

post.description: Creates a model response using the OpenAI Responses API format via Bedrock Mantle. Supports multi-turn conversations, built-in tool use, and structured outputs. Supports streaming via server-sent events when stream is set to true.

schema.description: SSE stream of response events when stream is true

post.description: Creates a model response using the Anthropic Messages API format via Bedrock Mantle. Supports streaming via server-sent events when stream is set to true.

schema.description: SSE stream of message events when stream is true

post.description: Invokes the specified Amazon Bedrock model to run inference using the prompt and inference parameters in the request body. The body format is specific to the model family.

parameters.description: Model identifier: model ID, inference profile ID, or ARN (foundation model, inference profile, provisioned model, imported model, or prompt ARN).
parameters.name: model

200.description: Successful inference response; body format is model-family specific

post.description: Invokes the specified Amazon Bedrock model to run inference, returning the response as a stream of event-stream frames. The request body format is identical to the non-streaming InvokeModel operation.

parameters.description: Model identifier: model ID, inference profile ID, or ARN (foundation model, inference profile, provisioned model, imported model, or prompt ARN).
parameters.name: model

schema.description: AWS event-stream frames; payload format is model-family specific

post.summary: Invoke a Bedrock model with response stream

model.description: Bedrock model ID to use (e.g., us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, amazon.nova-pro-v1:0, openai.gpt-oss-120b)

messages.description: List of messages comprising the conversation

temperature.description: Sampling temperature between 0 and 2. Higher values make output more random.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling parameter. Consider tokens with top_p probability mass.

n.description: Number of chat completion choices to generate

stream.description: If true, partial message deltas are sent as server-sent events

include_usage.description: If true, include usage statistics in the streaming response

stop.description: Up to 4 sequences where the API will stop generating tokens

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate (deprecated, use max_completion_tokens)

max_completion_tokens.description: Upper bound on tokens the model can generate

presence_penalty.description: Penalizes new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far (-2.0 to 2.0)

frequency_penalty.description: Penalizes new tokens based on their frequency in the text so far (-2.0 to 2.0)

logit_bias.description: Modify likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion

logprobs.description: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens

top_logprobs.description: Number of most likely tokens to return at each position (0-20)

response_format.description: Format the model must output (e.g., json_object, json_schema)

type.description: Response format type: text, json_object, or json_schema

tools.description: List of tools the model may call

tool_choice.description: Controls which tool is called by the model

parallel_tool_calls.description: Whether to enable parallel function calling

amazon-bedrock-guardrailConfig.description: Amazon Bedrock Guardrails configuration passed in the request body

tagSuffix.description: Tag suffix for input tagging with guardrails

id.description: Unique identifier for the chat completion

created.description: Unix timestamp of when the completion was created

index.description: Index of the choice in the list

finish_reason.description: Reason the model stopped generating: stop, length, tool_calls, content_filter

role.description: Role of the message author: system, user, assistant, tool

tool_calls.description: Tool calls generated by the model (assistant messages)

tool_call_id.description: ID of the tool call this message is responding to (tool messages)

AssistantMessage.description: A message generated by the assistant.

content.description: Text content of the message (null if tool_calls present)

tool_calls.description: Tool calls the model wants to make

refusal.description: Refusal message if the model declined

ContentPart.description: A content part within a message (for multimodal inputs).

image_url.description: Image URL content (when type is image_url)

url.description: URL of the image or base64 data URI

detail.description: Image detail level: auto, low, high

description.description: Description of what the function does

parameters.description: JSON Schema describing the function parameters

strict.description: Whether to enforce strict parameter schema adherence

ToolCall.description: A tool call generated by the model.

id.description: Unique ID of the tool call

type.description: Type of tool call, currently only 'function'

name.description: Name of the function to call

arguments.description: JSON string of arguments to pass to the function

prompt_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the prompt

completion_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the generated completion

param.description: The parameter that caused the error

input.description: Input to the model (text or array of input items)

stream.description: If true, response events are streamed via SSE

tool_choice.description: How the model should use tools

output.description: Output items generated by the model

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate

stream.description: If true, response events are streamed via SSE

tool_choice.description: How the model should use tools

stop_reason.description: Reason for stopping: end_turn, max_tokens, stop_sequence, tool_use

InvokeModelRequest.description: Union of InvokeModel request body fields across all Bedrock model families reachable via InvokeModel (text, image, video, and embedding models). No field is required because no field is common to every family; additional properties are allowed for forward compatibility. Numeric ranges are intentionally omitted where they differ per family.

audio.description: OpenAI: parameters for audio output (voice, format). Platform feature; Bedrock acceptance unverified.

chat_history.description: Prior turns, [{role: USER|CHATBOT, message}]. (Cohere Command R/R+)

colorGuidedGenerationParams.description: (Titan Image V2, taskType=COLOR_GUIDED_GENERATION) {text(req), colors(req, 1-10 hex), negativeText, referenceImage}

frequencyPenalty.description: Penalty object {scale, applyToWhitespaces?, applyToPunctuations?, applyToNumbers?, applyToStopwords?, applyToEmojis?}. (AI21 Jurassic-2)

frequency_penalty.description: Frequency penalty. (Jamba, Cohere Command R/R+ 0-1, Palmyra -2..2)

function_call.description: OpenAI (deprecated, replaced by tool_choice): forces/selects legacy function calling. Deprecated in the OpenAI spec but still legal on the wire; included so policy conditions can reference it.

functions.description: OpenAI (deprecated, replaced by tools): legacy function definitions. Deprecated in the OpenAI spec but still legal on the wire; included so policy conditions can reference it.

image.description: Base64 input image. (Stability i2i + all Image Services except Style Transfer)

imageGenerationConfig.description: (Titan Image, shared) {quality: standard|premium, numberOfImages 1-5, height, width, cfgScale 1.1-10.0, seed 0-2147483646}

images.description: Image inputs as strings: base64 (Meta Llama 3.2+) or data URIs (Cohere Embed v3 max 1 / v4 max 96, exclusive with texts).

inPaintingParams.description: (Titan Image, taskType=INPAINTING) {image(req), maskPrompt|maskImage(one req), text, negativeText, returnMask}

inputImage.description: Base64 image to embed. (Titan Multimodal Embeddings)

inputText.description: Text prompt / text to embed. (Titan Text, Titan Embeddings Text, Titan Multimodal Embeddings)

input_type.description: Embedding use-case marker; 'image' is v3-only. (Cohere Embed v3/v4)

inputs.description: Interleaved multimodal items [{content:[{type:text,text}|{type:image_url,image_url:{url}}]}], max 96. (Cohere Embed v4)

k.description: Top-K, bare name, 0-500. (Cohere Command, Command R/R+)

logprobs.description: OpenAI: whether to return log probabilities of output tokens.

maxTokens.description: Max tokens to generate, camelCase. (AI21 Jurassic-2)

max_tokens.description: Max tokens to generate. REQUIRED for Claude. (Claude, Mistral, Jamba, Cohere, DeepSeek, Palmyra; also Cohere Embed v4 truncation budget)

mediaSource.description: (TwelveLabs Pegasus) video source; exactly one of base64String/s3Location.

messages.description: Conversation turns. Item shape varies by family: content may be a plain string (Mistral chat, Jamba, OpenAI, Palmyra), an array of typed blocks (Claude text/image; Pixtral text/image_url; Nova text/image/video/audio), or an object {text} (Palmyra). Tool-result turns add tool_call_id (Mistral) / tool_calls.

content.description: string | array of content blocks | object — family-specific; blocks include {type:text,text}, {type:image,source:{type:base64,media_type,data}} (Claude), {type:image_url,image_url:{url}} (Pixtral), {text}/{image:{format,source:{bytes}}}/{video}/{audio} (Nova)

metadata.description: OpenAI: up to 16 string key-value pairs attached to the object. Platform feature; Bedrock acceptance unverified.

modalities.description: OpenAI: output types to generate, e.g. ["text"], ["text","audio"]. Platform feature; Bedrock acceptance unverified.

model.description: Model identifier. Two origins: (a) OpenAI gpt-oss body field; (b) the path-materialized parameter injected by Policy from the {model} capability template.

moderation.description: OpenAI: configuration for running moderation on request input/output (model, policy). Platform feature; Bedrock acceptance unverified.

n.description: Number of responses, 1-16; must be 1 when streaming. (AI21 Jamba)

outPaintingParams.description: (Titan Image, taskType=OUTPAINTING) {image(req), maskPrompt|maskImage(one req), text(req), negativeText, returnMask, outPaintingMode: DEFAULT|PRECISE}

p.description: Top-P, bare name. (Cohere Command, Command R/R+)

parallel_tool_calls.description: OpenAI: whether to enable parallel function calling during tool use.

preamble.description: Overrides default preamble for search query generation. (Cohere Command R/R+)

prediction.description: OpenAI: static predicted output content (Predicted Outputs).

presence_penalty.description: Presence penalty. (Jamba, Cohere Command R/R+ 0-1, Palmyra -2..2)

prompt.description: Text prompt. (Meta Llama, Mistral text, AI21 Jurassic-2, Cohere Command, DeepSeek, Stability generation/services)

prompt_cache_key.description: OpenAI: cache routing key for prompt caching. Platform feature; Bedrock acceptance unverified.

prompt_cache_options.description: OpenAI: prompt caching options (ttl, mode). Platform feature; Bedrock acceptance unverified.

prompt_cache_retention.description: OpenAI (deprecated): prompt cache retention policy (in_memory | 24h). Deprecated in the OpenAI spec but still legal on the wire; included so policy conditions can reference it.

response_format.description: OpenAI: output format constraint - {type: text|json_object|json_schema, json_schema: {...}}.

safety_identifier.description: OpenAI: stable end-user identifier for safety monitoring. Platform feature; Bedrock acceptance unverified.

seed.description: Deterministic sampling seed. (Cohere Command R/R+, Palmyra, Stability families)

service_tier.description: OpenAI: processing tier (auto/default/flex/priority/...). Platform feature; Bedrock acceptance unverified.

stop.description: Stop sequences. (Mistral text <=10, Jamba, DeepSeek <=10, Palmyra <=4)

stopSequences.description: Stop sequences, camelCase. (AI21 Jurassic-2; also nested in Titan/Nova configs)

stop_sequences.description: Stop sequences. (Claude <=8191 entries, Cohere Command <=4, Cohere Command R/R+)

store.description: OpenAI: whether to store the completion for distillation/evals. Platform feature; Bedrock acceptance unverified.

stream.description: Explicit streaming flag. (Cohere Command: required true for streaming; OpenAI: must be false for InvokeModel)

stream_options.description: OpenAI: streaming options - include_usage, include_obfuscation. NOTE: the gateway itself injects stream_options.include_usage on the OpenAI chat path when the account has a TPM limit.

style_preset.description: 17-value style enum (3d-model, anime, cinematic, ...). (Stability Image Services)

system.description: System prompt: string (Claude) or array of blocks — [{text}] (Nova) / [{type:text,text}] (Claude array form).

taskType.description: Task discriminator — selects which *Params object applies. (Titan Image Generator)

temperature.description: Sampling randomness. Ranges differ per family: 0-1 (Claude/Llama/Mistral/Cohere-R/DeepSeek/Pegasus), 0-2 (Jamba/Palmyra), 0-5 (Cohere Command).

textToImageParams.description: (Titan Image, taskType=TEXT_IMAGE) {text(req), negativeText, conditionImage(V2), controlMode: CANNY_EDGE|SEGMENTATION(V2), controlStrength(V2)}

texts.description: Texts to embed, max 96, exclusive with images. (Cohere Embed v3/v4)

tool_choice.description: Tool selection. SHAPE VARIES: object {type: any|auto|tool, name?} (Claude) vs string enum auto|any|none (Mistral chat).

tool_results.description: Results of tool invocations [{call:{name,parameters}, outputs:[...]}]. (Cohere Command R/R+)

tools.description: Tool definitions. Item shape varies: Claude {type:custom|computer_20241022|bash_20241022|text_editor_20241022, name, description, input_schema, display_*}; Mistral/Pixtral {type:function, function:{name, description, parameters}}; Cohere Command R {name, description, parameter_definitions}.

topP.description: Nucleus sampling, camelCase. (AI21 Jurassic-2; also nested in Titan/Nova configs)

top_logprobs.description: OpenAI: number of most likely tokens (0-20) to return per position; requires logprobs=true.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling, snake_case. (Claude, Llama, Mistral, Jamba, DeepSeek, OpenAI, Palmyra)

truncate.description: Over-length input handling. Enum values differ per family: NONE|START|END (Cohere Command, Embed v3) vs NONE|LEFT|RIGHT (Embed v4).

user.description: OpenAI (deprecated, replaced by safety_identifier/prompt_cache_key): end-user identifier. Deprecated in the OpenAI spec but still legal on the wire; included so policy conditions can reference it.

web_search_options.description: OpenAI: web search tool options (user_location, search_context_size). Platform feature; Bedrock acceptance unverified.

InvokeModelResponse.description: Union of non-streaming InvokeModel response body fields across all Bedrock model families reachable via InvokeModel (text, image, video, and embedding models). No field is required because a response only carries its own family's fields; additional properties are allowed for forward compatibility. Fields whose shape differs by family are oneOf.

index.description: Index of the choice in the list

logprobs.description: Log probability information for the choice

annotations.description: Annotations for the message, such as web search citations

refusal.description: Refusal message generated by the model

arguments.description: Arguments to pass to the function

end.description: Zero-based index where the citation ends

start.description: Zero-based index where the citation begins

logprob.description: Log probability of the token after sampling

raw_logprob.description: Raw log probability of the token

textRange.description: Offsets of the token in the decoded text

logprob.description: Log probability of the alternative token

finishReason.description: Why generation stopped for this completion

created.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the completion was created

embeddings.description: Embeddings of the input: a list of vectors, or an object keyed by embedding type when several types are requested

embeddingsByType.description: Embeddings keyed by embedding type (float, binary)

error.description: Error returned when the content is flagged by the content moderation policy

finish_reason.description: Why generation stopped (e.g. complete, max_tokens, error)

finish_reasons.description: Whether the request was filtered; null when successful

generation_token_count.description: Number of tokens in the generated text

likelihood.description: Average token likelihood of the output

items.description: A generated image (base64 string) or an image description

inputTextTokenCount.description: Number of tokens in the input

inputs.description: Inputs the embeddings were returned for

items.description: A content part (e.g. text or image_url)

message.description: Generated message, or an error message

reasoningContent.description: Reasoning content, when reasoning is enabled

toolUse.description: Tool use requested by the model

prompt.description: Prompt sent to the model, as text or as text with tokens

logprob.description: Log probability of the token after sampling

completionReason.description: Why generation stopped (e.g. FINISHED, LENGTH, CONTENT_FILTERED)

tokenCount.description: Number of tokens in the generated text

seeds.description: Seeds used to generate the images

service_tier.description: Service tier used for the request
